patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patcher from the link below Run 'vrkanojo_steam_ex.exe', click on the left of the two buttons at the bottom - this will extract the patch files to the current directory Enter the 'vrkanojo_steam_ex' folder, and copy the 'abdata' folder into the game install folder mention
